item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President makes the statutory emergency and national-interest determinations that presently activate authority to provide assistance beyond otherwise available funds; subsequent implementation is ministerial.","evidence":"I hereby determine that"},{"segment_id":"2","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently orders a legally consequential drawdown of Defense Department commodities and services, capped at $2 million, rather than directing an agency to decide the outcome later.","evidence":"I therefore direct the drawdown of commodities and services"}]}
